items.title: AI Slowdown Is More Macro Than Tied to One Company: T.Rowe Price’s Wang
items.title_ko: AI Slowdown Is More Macro Than Tied to One Company: T.Rowe Price’s Wang
items.summary_ko: Tony Wang, Portfolio Manager at T.Rowe Price, says investors are looking for AI-related spending to translate into better-than-expected revenue across companies’ core businesses and cloud operations, while also improving margins. He describes demand for AI chips as unprecedented, but warns that rapid shipments can strain supply chains and create bottlenecks, raising execution expectations.

items.title: Breaking Down Amazon's Third-Quarter Earnings
items.summary_ko: Amazon spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in the third quarter, far more than analysts’ estimates, while pursuing its effort to build data centers and fulfill demand for AI services. Anurag Rana and Poonam Goyal break down the numbers on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
